messages.text:
What it is: Swarm relaunch into a drained backlog no longer auto-hibernates before the coordinator can triage queued work
What it solves: BL-307 shipped the closing-pass auto-hibernate/auto-relaunch pair. This
defect is a race in the DOWN-trigger: a freshly (re)started
`operator_runtime.bb` evaluates the closing pass on its normal tick
(`OPERATOR_INTERVAL_MS`, currently 30000ms) starting immediately at
process start. If `backlog/acti…
How it works: The closing pass never hibernates within 2 minutes of the runtime's own process start, even when the backlog is drained and the roster is idle
